goal: How many running activities did I do this week in the OpenTracks app? Assume the week starts from Monday. Express your answer as a single integer.
summary:
I counted **2** running activities in OpenTracks for this week (Mon Oct 9 – Sun Oct 15), and submitted that answer.

The two are:
- **"Trying and failing to keep up with John"** on Saturday (yesterday)
- **"Active Rest Day"** on Friday, Oct 13

The track list doesn't name each track's activity type, so I went by the activity icons. Both of these have the running icon. I opened "Active Rest Day" and its detail page also shows the running icon, but no activity type written out. I didn't open "Trying and failing to keep up with John" or the walking tracks.

I left out "Trail Hike" (Friday) and "Hill Walk" (Tuesday) because they show a walking icon. If either of those was logged as a run, the answer would be higher. The other tracks from this week are cycling, skiing, climbing and skateboarding.
